title: decalobanthus korthalsianus
intro: Decalobanthus korthalsianus, commonly known as "Coral Tree" or "Red Ironbark," is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Decalobanthus korthalsianus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
